reading.title: From Waking Up to Leaving Home
reading.text: When the alarm rings, Yusuf wakes up and gets up. He yawns, stretches and showers. He brushes his teeth and gets dressed. Then he eats breakfast and packs lunch before leaving home. At breakfast, he eats bread and drinks water. He chews before swallowing, then sips his coffee.
reading.imageBrief: Clothed adult morning preparation with closed work bag, bread and cup on table. No bathroom actions at the breakfast table, readable text or precise clock requirement.

Read the passage: When the alarm rings, Yusuf wakes up and gets up. He yawns, stretches and showers. He brushes his teeth and gets dressed. Then he eats breakfast and packs lunch before leaving home. At breakfast, he eats bread and drinks water. He chews before swallowing, then sips his coffee.
What does Yusuf pack before leaving home?
Say you wake up before you get up.
exercises.answer: I wake up before I get up.

exercises.prompt: Ask a colleague whether they pack lunch for work.

reading.title: Daily Action Verbs 2: A Practical Daily Routine
reading.text: At lunch Sam gulps water, takes a bite of bread and tastes soup. He licks his own spoon. A slurp makes a sound. Later Maya cooks dinner. She cleans the counter, washes bowls, sweeps the floor and vacuums the rug. She irons and folds a shirt, organizes books, asks a carpenter to repair a chair and decorates the room.

reading.title: Daily Action Verbs 3: A Practical Daily Routine
reading.text: Omar bathes, shaves, combs his hair and styles it. He applies lotion to moisturize his hands. A barber trims his hair. reading.text: On Sunday Lina wants to unwind after a busy week. She sits quietly to meditate, then reads on the sofa. Later she begins to doze. Her brother sometimes snores when he sleeps, but the house is quiet today. The restful afternoon helps Lina recharge before Monday.
